metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the porch, a struck letter, and the word likely shut into the coffer lid.

yesterday: You spoke the crack again, and you turned to the letter.
The sword went before Sir John for the last Sunday.
The letter waits in the coffer lid for the carrier of the thirteenth. Likely is the word.
The loaf is a penny, and a full thumb short of the notch.
